headlines.title: Stocks showing promise of a rally: Brokerage expects up to 10% return; know target price
headlines.description: Bharti Airtel, Naukri, and ITC Hotels are three stocks that are showing signs of a rally that can fetch up to 10% returns, says the technical research analyst of Choice Broking. He has assigned a target price of ₹2,010 for Bharti Airtel, ₹1,395 for Naukri and ₹178 for ITC Hotels. Learn about the technical setup, RSI, EMA, and stop-loss levels for all three stocks.

headlines.title: HDFC, ICICI or Axis Bank: Post Q2 results, which stock is showing the highest potential?
headlines.description: In the July-September quarter, ICICI Bank’s standalone profit rose by 20.1% to ₹14,843 crore. HDFC Bank’s profit increased by 4.7% to ₹19,510 crore, while Axis Bank’s profit grew by 37.6% to ₹7,003 crore. Each of the three banks showed distinct trends regarding margins, loan growth, and asset quality.
headlines.author: Avijit Ghosal
